### Added 14 Missing Struct Definitions
1. Rectangle - Graphics rectangle (MinX, MinY, MaxX, MaxY)

3. RastPort - Graphics rendering port
4. Layer - Graphics layer management
5. Hook - Utility callback hook structure

7. IBox - Intuition bounding box
8. DrawInfo - Screen drawing information

10. Window - Intuition window structure
11. Requester - Intuition requester structure
12. Gadget - Intuition gadget structure
13. NewWindow - Window initialization structure
14. GadgetInfo - Gadget rendering information

### Fixed Struct Ordering (Forward References)
Moved 4 structs to be defined before use:
- WBArg: line 1524 → 951 (before AppMessage)
- RootNode: line 1140 → 1127 (before DosLibrary)
- AChain: line 1275 → 1263 (before AnchorPath)
- NotifyRequest: line 1300 → 1291 (before NotifyMessage)

### Fixed Constant References
Replaced symbolic constants with literal values in array sizes:
- GLOBALSZ → 200
- RXBUFFSZ → 204
- MAXFONTPATH → 256
- MAXFONTNAME → 32
- MAXFONTPATH-2 → 254

This prevents module loading conflicts when importing both
amiga_structs and amiga_consts.
